# kion_app_api_key (Resource)

Manages a Kion App Api Key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_app_api_key" "example" {
  # Required
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the key in the application.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App API Key ID.
